public class TrailGate {
    private int capacity;
    private int admitted;
    private static int totalAdmitted;
    public static final int MAX_GROUP_SIZE = 8;

    public TrailGate(int maxVisitors) {
        capacity = maxVisitors;
        admitted = 0;
    }

    public boolean admitGroup(int groupSize) {
        if (groupSize <= 0 || groupSize > MAX_GROUP_SIZE || admitted + groupSize > capacity) {
            return false;
        }
        admitted += groupSize;
        totalAdmitted += groupSize;
        return true;
    }

    public int getAdmitted() {
        return admitted;
    }

    public static int getTotalAdmitted() {
        return totalAdmitted;
    }

    public static boolean canAdmitGroup(TrailGate gate, int groupSize) {
        return groupSize > 0 && groupSize <= TrailGate.MAX_GROUP_SIZE
               && gate.admitted + groupSize <= gate.capacity;
    }
}
